supermarket_sales.Branch: Name of the branch where the sale occurred.
supermarket_sales.Customer type: Classification of the customer as either a member or a regular.
supermarket_sales.Gender: Gender of the customer, either male or female.
supermarket_sales.Unit price: Price of a single unit of the product (in تومان).
supermarket_sales.Tax 5%: Amount of tax applied at 5% of the subtotal (in تومان).
supermarket_sales.Total: Total amount charged for the invoice (in تومان).
supermarket_sales.Date: Date of the transaction (in DD/MM/YYYY format).
supermarket_sales.Time: Time of the transaction (in HH:MM format).
supermarket_sales.Payment: Method of payment used for the transaction.
supermarket_sales.cogs: Cost of goods sold for the transaction (in تومان).
supermarket_sales.gross margin percentage: Percentage representing the gross margin relative to total sales.
supermarket_sales.gross income: Total income generated from the transaction (in تومان).
supermarket_sales.Rating: Customer satisfaction rating for the transaction (out of 10).
